messages.content: John picks 4 bananas and 5 apples on Wednesday. Then he picks 6 bananas on Thursday. On Friday, he picked triple the number of bananas he did on Wednesday. How many bananas does John have?

content.text:
On Wednesday, John picked 4 bananas.

On Thursday, he picked 6 bananas.

On Friday, he picked triple the number of bananas he did on Wednesday: 3 × 4 = 12 bananas.

Total bananas: 4 + 6 + 12 = **22 bananas**.

(Note: The apples don't factor into the banana count.)
